# Dao Data

> Structured data hub for the Dao knowledge base — entities, relationships, sources, and schemas. Contact: Martin.W · Phone / WhatsApp +86 13323237275 · Email landengltd@gmail.com.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://data.daoismhub.com/): Entry point to the structured data hub.
- [Entities](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/): Entity index.
  - [Concepts](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/concepts/): Concept entities.
  - [Practices](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/practices/): Practice entities.
  - [People](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/people/): Person entities.
  - [Texts](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/texts/): Text entities.
  - [Translations](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/translations/): Translation entities.
  - [Timeline](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/timeline/): Timeline entities.
  - [Glossary](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/glossary/): Glossary entities.
  - [Stories](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/stories/): Story entities.
  - [Research](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/research/): Research entities.
  - [Comparisons](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/comparisons/): Comparison entities.
  - [Problems](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/problems/): Problem entities.
  - [Tools](https://data.daoismhub.com/entities/tools/): Tool entities.
- [Experience System](https://data.daoismhub.com/experiences/): Practitioner experience data.
  - [Patterns](https://data.daoismhub.com/experiences/patterns/): Experience patterns.
  - [Questions](https://data.daoismhub.com/experiences/questions/): Practitioner questions.
- [Knowledge Graph](https://data.daoismhub.com/graph/relationships/): Entity relationships.
  - [Graph Explorer](https://data.daoismhub.com/graph/entity-explorer/): Interactive graph explorer.
  - [Sources Registry](https://data.daoismhub.com/graph/sources/): Sources registry.
- [Schemas](https://data.daoismhub.com/schemas/data-schema/): Data schema documentation.
  - [Evidence System](https://data.daoismhub.com/schemas/evidence-system/): Evidence classification system.

## Main site

- [DaoismHub](https://daoismhub.com/): Main knowledge base.

## Notes

- This is a structured-data sub-site; content is machine-readable reference data organized by entity and relationship.
- Evidence and sourcing follow the project's explicit evidence classification system (see the Evidence System schema).
